# Saturn 3D Precision Manufacturing

> Premier Industrial 3D Printing & Rapid Prototyping Facility serving Bhopal, Indore, Madhya Pradesh, and Pan-India.

Saturn 3D operates high-speed CoreXY print farms and ultra-high-resolution 12K SLA resin facilities in Central India (Sector B, Govindpura Industrial Area, Bhopal, MP 462023 with daily express logistics corridors to Indore and Pithampur). We specialize in functional prototypes, low-volume batch production (10 to 5,000+ units), automotive jigs, and precision medical/engineering models with verified tolerances down to ±0.04mm.

## Primary Regional Hubs

- **Bhopal Facility**: Sector B, Govindpura Industrial Area, Bhopal, MP 462023. Walk-in pickups, same-day fabrication, on-site metrology inspection. Phone: +91 88899 88874. URL: https://saturn3d.in/3d-printing-in-bhopal
- **Indore & Pithampur Corridor**: Dedicated daily highway express shuttle (3.5h transit) providing 12–24h doorstep delivery across Pithampur Auto Cluster, Sanwer Road, Electronic Complex, and Vijay Nagar. URL: https://saturn3d.in/3d-printing-in-indore

## Additive Manufacturing Capabilities & Materials

- **Carbon-X PA12-CF**: High-tensile continuous micro carbon fiber matrix (115 MPa tensile yield, replaces CNC 6061 aluminum) for robotic end-effectors, automotive brackets, and drone airframes.
- **12K Precision SLA Resin**: Sub-micron photopolymer printing with 25-micron layers for microfluidics, aesthetic consumer hardware enclosures, and anatomical surgical drill templates.
- **ABS-ESD Flame Retardant**: Electrostatic discharge safe polymer with 98°C thermal deflection for electronic assembly fixtures.
- **PETG Industrial Chemical Grade**: Ductile, shatterproof, chemical and water-resistant mechanical parts.
- **PLA Pro Precision**: Ultra-low shrinkage rapid iteration for form and fit verification.

## Specifications & Turnaround

- **Dimensional Tolerances**: Down to ±0.04mm verified metrology.
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)**: Zero (0 MOQ - single prototype to 5,000+ production units).
- **Lead Time**: 24–48 hours standard; same-day rush turnaround available in Bhopal; 12–24h delivery to Indore.
- **Pricing**: From ₹3.50/g (FDM PLA Pro), ₹6/g (PETG), ₹14/ml (12K SLA), ₹25/g (Carbon-X PA12). Full 18% GST Input Tax Credit (ITC) corporate invoicing.
